lines.text: Eighty men from Shechem, Shiloh, and Samaria bring offerings for the house of the LORD, and Ishmael meets them weeping.
Ishmael slaughters most of the men and fills a cistern King Ahab made for fear of Baasha.
Ishmael takes Mizpah's people captive toward the Philistines, but Johanan finds him at Gibeon and the captives join Johanan.
